route_end: finish service at last assigned task; no return to start

map.safety_buffer: forbidden boat-center nodes within Chebyshev distance 1 of any obstacle; clipped to map
map.straight_line_check: a Euclidean segment is blocked if it touches a closed 1m x 1m square centered on any forbidden node; touching the square boundary counts as collision

unreachable_diagnostic.purpose: verify unreachable returns null path and null distance; never part of main case or assigned zero cost

previous_assignment_reference.definition: sum of fixed boat-start-to-assigned-task Euclidean distances; excludes task-to-task route legs
